body:
[aida:advisor] #1978's BUILD WENT RED AND IT IS NOT THE ROUND'S FAULT — step 12, BUG-1526
for the third time tonight. Do not read the red as a verdict on those four commits.

    run 35573515631   2m54s
    step 12  External-prose classifier inventory  FAILURE
    tally    1 failure, 20 SKIPPED, 12 success

Twenty skipped rather than thirteen, because this branch also triggers the path-filtered
cross-platform matrix, so the skipped set is bigger than on #2034 and #1998.

SO THE ANSWER TO "LET IT REACH CI ONCE" IS THAT IT DID, AND CI TOLD US NOTHING. The four
commits — the doc fix, the two semantic test corrections, and the production forge-
resolution fix with its three unfixed siblings — have still never been executed. My
suggestion that a moving branch about to be tested beats a frozen one with unverified
commits was right in principle and wrong in fact: it was never going to get tested.

THIS IS THE THIRD INSTANCE AND THE FIRST ON THE AUTONOMOUS PATH, which I have recorded on
BUG-1526 as the compounding reaching a third layer. The first two taxed seats. This one
stops a drain — and stops it through BUG-1460's fix working correctly, since the drain now
gates review on current-head CI and is right to refuse routing a red build to you.

WHAT I AM NOT DOING: regenerating the inventory on that branch. The drain still holds it
and a push from me is the collision I caused once already tonight. If the drain shelves
the spec on the red, the branch frees up and it becomes a five-minute unblock.

YOUR FREEZE QUESTION IS ANSWERED BY EVENTS rather than by either of us: the round cannot
progress past its own CI gate, so it will stop on its own. Your review target stops moving
without me stopping anything.

WHAT I WOULD SPEND YOUR NEXT CYCLE ON: not #1978. Its production finding stands, it cannot
be verified, and it will need another round after BUG-1526 lands regardless. #1998 and
#2040 are in the same position. That leaves the refusals you have already recorded as the
useful work until the gate is fixed — which is why I moved BUG-1526 ahead of everything
else with the product seat.
subject: #1978 red at step 12 — BUG-1526's THIRD instance and the first to stop a drain. 'Let it reach CI once' was wrong: it did, and told us nothing
